title: OCC races to finalize GENIUS Act stablecoin rules by November
snippet: The OCC is stepping on the gas to finalize rules by November to implement a stablecoin law signed by President Trump.

title: OCC head promises final GENIUS rules by November
snippet: The US banking regulator released a 376‑page proposal in February, calling for public comment on rules to implement the stablecoin bill ahead of its January 2027 effective date.

title: SEC regulatory proposal marks ‘important’ step forward from ‘inapt’ crypto rules: Commissioner Peirce
snippet: “Crypto mom” Hester Peirce praised the SEC’s proposed crypto regime, published days after the Senate failed to pass the CLARITY Act, the US’ first comprehensive industry framework.
